Name: No glasses or mustache Harvey Sprite
Author: ashlee1012000
Description:
This coincides with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/888]DCBurger's portrait mod[/url]﻿ where you have the option to select a no glasses/no mustache Harvey.

Simply download the file and use it to replace Harvey.xnb under your game file>Content>Characters.
[b]
BE SURE TO BACKUP YOUR ORIGINAL GAME FILE[/b]
